### Outliers Removed

We remove any outlier samples (scoring using median ICI-Kt), and redo all the calculations.

```{r}
#| label: not-outliers
not_outlier_variances = create_variance_values(
  pca_data$not_outlier$pca$variance,
  ind = max_ind,
  group = max_group
)
```

#### Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: not-outlier-heatmap
#| fig-cap: ICI-Kt sample-sample correlation heatmap, with correlation values, with outlier samples removed.
use_graphs$iterative_plots$not_outlier$heatmap
```

#### Median Correlations

```{r}
#| label: not-outlier-median
#| fig-cap: Median ICI-Kt sample-sample correlations by sample factors, with outlier samples removed.
use_graphs$iterative_plots$not_outlier$median_ici
```

#### Group Scores

```{r}
#| label: tbl-not-outlier-icikt-scores
#| tbl-cap: Count (n_differences) and fraction (differences_fraction) of samples where between factors median ICI-Kt was higher than the within factors median ICI-Kt. Outlier samples removed.
pca_data$not_outlier$scores |>
  create_grouping_scores_table("median-ici")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-not-outlier-rle-scores

  create_grouping_scores_table("rle")
```
